task: web session UX states; audit tests in services/api/tests/test_auth_*.py, web e2e session handling, expired session redirections, silent refresh behavior.

silent_refresh_flow.trigger: Axios interceptor intercepts 401 on non-bypass, non-refresh request
silent_refresh_flow.action: Single-flight POST /api/v1/auth/refresh with HttpOnly cookies or rotated token
silent_refresh_flow.success_outcome: Seamless request retry with fresh credentials; no UI disruption
silent_refresh_flow.failure_outcome: bestEffortServerLogout, local token purge, redirect to /login?next=<encoded_path>

public_routes_isolation.rule: Public surfaces (landing, /login, /legal/*, /huong-dan) must NEVER bounce on background 401s
public_routes_isolation.implementation: AUTH_FAILURE_REDIRECT_SKIP_PREFIXES in http-client.ts and isPublicRoute in SessionBoundary

token_security_and_rotation.key_rotation: JWT_SECRET_KEY and JWT_SECRET_KEY_PREVIOUS dual-key verification grace period
token_security_and_rotation.reuse_prevention: Single-use refresh token invalidation; replay immediately revokes session and rejects with 401
token_security_and_rotation.bearer_cookie_separation: Malformed or invalid Bearer tokens fail-closed with 401; no fallback to cookie credentials
